title: Dinner with friends
situation: Friends are coming over Saturday. Tell me what you need!
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. Help with what they ask.

pieces.label: Plan dinner for 6 friends on Saturday
pieces.text: Plan a dinner for 6 friends this Saturday.

pieces.label: Sam is vegetarian
pieces.text: One of my friends, Sam, is vegetarian.

pieces.label: Make it amazing
pieces.tip: "Make it amazing" sounds nice, but it gives Pipo nothing concrete to work with.

slots.label: What should the answer look like?

pieces.label: The menu and a short shopping list
pieces.text: Give me the menu and a short shopping list.

pieces.label: Tell me everything
pieces.text: Tell me everything I should know.
pieces.tip: "Tell me everything" gets you a long answer that's hard to use.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo that Sam is vegetarian.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know Sam is vegetarian, so the menu has meat in it.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo your budget.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your budget, so the plan has no prices at all.

flaws.hint: "Help me with dinner" doesn't say who's coming or when, so Pipo has to guess.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know 6 people are coming, so it planned for the wrong number.

lesson: Pipo only knows what you tell it. Put the facts that matter in your prompt.
